subject: CSA questionnaire — control evidence logistics and delivery plan
content:
From: Carolyn Ruiz <carolyn.ruiz@orchidbank.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: audit@orchidbank.com
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 16:14:00 +0000
Subject: CSA questionnaire — control mapping and artifacts — next steps

Hi Mina / Marissa,

Thanks again for the initial package you uploaded to the Drive. We did a quick pass and have three follow-ups: 1) we need a clearer mapping row for CCM control CC-6 (data-in-transit encryption) showing the exact artifact that proves TLS enforcement on inter-service traffic; 2) a sample of access logs that show IAM role activity for the month of September; and 3) confirmation of KMS rotation policy (screenshot or export).

Can you let me know if you can deliver these items by COB Tuesday (Nov 2)? If not, please propose a timeline. We also prefer the mapping file to include a column that points to the exact Drive path for each artifact.

Best,
Carolyn

--
Carolyn Ruiz
Senior Security Analyst
Orchid Bank

-----
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Carolyn Ruiz <carolyn.ruiz@orchidbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 09:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: CSA questionnaire — control mapping and artifacts — next steps

Hi Carolyn —

Thanks for the clear ask. Short answer: yes, we can deliver. Quick notes on scope and owners:

- CC-6 (data-in-transit): Jonas Weber will export the ALB/NLB TLS policy and a small packet-capture proof from our internal test cluster that shows mTLS is enforced between model-serving pods.
- IAM role activity logs: we can provide an anonymized sample of September CloudTrail entries and a short readme showing how to reproduce the filter.
- KMS rotation: we will include the KMS policy screenshot plus a short timeline of rotation cadence.

We plan to upload everything to the shared Drive folder and will add a \"Drive path\" column to the mapping spreadsheet so each artifact links directly to the file.

I will own the delivery; Marissa will validate artifacts for scope and redaction; Kimberly will sign off on the mapping file finalization. ETA: EOD Monday (Nov 1) in UTC, unless you prefer local times.

How do you prefer the access logs delivered? Plain text sample (redacted) or a zipped CSV?

Thanks,
Mina

--
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 11:37:00 +0000
Subject: Re: CSA questionnaire — control mapping and artifacts — next steps

Mina / team,
I captured the TLS policy and a 20-line packet snip from the staging cluster showing TLS handshakes between our inference pods (service-a -> service-b). Attaching the packet text as s3_access_log_sample.txt (note: this is a sanitized excerpt, actual PCAP retained internally if needed). I also exported the ALB policy JSON and added it to the Drive.
Attachment stubs: s3_access_log_sample.txt (text), ALB_TLS_policy.json (uploaded to Drive).
Jonas
--
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Carolyn Ruiz <carolyn.ruiz@orchidbank.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 31 Oct 2026 15:18:00 +0000
Subject: Draft mapping + artifact checklist (internal review)

Carolyn / Mina —

I uploaded a draft of the mapping spreadsheet (CSA_Control_Mapping_v1.3.xlsx) into the Drive folder and added a new column \"Drive path (artifact)\" with direct links to each uploaded file. Key decisions made:

- For controls that reference runtime telemetry (e.g., TE-3, TE-7), we included two representative artifacts rather than a full month export to reduce sensitivity.
- Access logs are provided as a redacted text sample + a filtering readme so you can request fuller exports through compliance if needed.
- KMS rotation proof is a screen capture of the rotation schedule and the policy snippet (kms_rotation_policy_snip.png).
A few outstanding items we flagged in-column: CC-6 needs confirmation that the ciphers listed are acceptable; TE-7 mapping depends on whether you need per-tenant logs (we currently provide global runtime logs).
Mina will route to you tomorrow for final internal signoff. Please review and flag anything you'd like changed.

Thanks,
Marissa

--
From: Carolyn Ruiz <carolyn.ruiz@orchidbank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: audit@orchidbank.com
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2026 09:46:00 +0000
Subject: Re: CSA questionnaire — control mapping and artifacts — next steps
Thanks Marissa — that looks good so far. A couple quick clarifications before we mark CC-6 traceable:
- On the ALB policy: can you confirm minimum accepted TLS version and whether we have any non-TLS listeners still in use?
- For the packet snip: please include the exact timestamp (UTC) and the source/destination service names (you can use internal service aliases, not IPs).
On TE-7 (runtime telemetry), per-tenant logs are preferred but not blocking for initial assessment — the readme is adequate for now.
If you can add those two items and re-upload by EOD today (Nov 1), we can close the sample loop and proceed to drafting the CSA narrative.
Best,
Carolyn

--
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Carolyn Ruiz <carolyn.ruiz@orchidbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2026 23:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: CSA questionnaire — control mapping and artifacts — next steps

Carolyn —
We updated the Drive folder with the two clarifying items you requested:

1) ALB policy addendum: the TLS minimum is TLS 1.2 (we have disabled TLS 1.0/1.1). No non-TLS listeners are present on inference ALBs; any legacy non-TLS endpoints are behind internal-only LB and not in scope for this assessment. Drive path: /OrchidBank/ALB_TLS_policy_addendum.json
2) Packet snip metadata: added exact UTC timestamp (2026-10-29T14:22:03Z) and internal service aliases (model-router -> encoder-service) in the filename header of s3_access_log_sample.txt.
Attachments included in Drive: CSA_Control_Mapping_v1.3.xlsx, s3_access_log_sample.txt, kms_rotation_policy_snip.png
We also included a short readme (artifact_readme.md) that explains the redaction approach and how to request full exports. If you want a per-tenant log extract for TE-7, we can run that as a separate export (we will need a signed DPA addendum — let us know and we can start the procurement thread).
Next steps: once you confirm the artifacts meet scope, we will draft the narrative responses for the CSA controls and provide a one-page executive summary for your audit team.
Thanks for the prompt feedback —
Mina Haddad
Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
